## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, before/after behavior and intended scope.

## Reproduction and evidence

Task/command or fixture; source/version/locator for research claims. Include Prior Art
base version/commit, runtime/model versions (or not applicable/not reported), available
tools/providers and relevant coverage status. Label synthetic evidence explicitly.

## Validation

List commands/scenarios actually run and results. Separate proposed checks and
unavailable tools from passing checks. Explain what the tests do not establish.

## Review notes

Compatibility/flag changes, retry or time budgets, counterexamples, privacy concerns
and any documentation/version updates required by this change.

- [ ] Reviewed output and attachments for private paths, customer data and secrets.
- [ ] Source observations, inferences and recommendations are distinguishable.
- [ ] Empty, failed and partial retrieval are not conflated where relevant.
- [ ] Reference code was not executed as part of research.
